digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and parser factories
propositions: Hand-maintained package help text drifts from runtime parser factory grammar, causing stale/incorrect option and argument documentation.
The help system must generate canonical, deterministic, parser-derived help artifacts for all registered routes before config parsing, store mounting, or handler resolution.
All visible canonical commands must appear exactly once in the grouped overview; aliases reuse canonical bytes and compatibility/hidden spellings follow approved naming rules.
Factory enrichment (help= text, description, epilog, SUPPRESS annotations) must be added to core and advanced parsers so curated prose lives in parser definitions and is rendered during generation.

Top-level help forms (--help, -h after command spelling, rebar help <command>) must serve committed generated artifacts via lexical pre-scan, completing before operation composition and optional imports.
Generator must enforce determinism, completeness, and stale/stray artifact detection via --check mode, with mandatory failure on blank per-command summaries or non-deterministic re-renders.
